gatekeeper.siteVisibility: Hidden until authenticated. Zero access to HUD or Flasher without active key.
gatekeeper.creditSystem: 1 Key = 1 Flash Credit. When flash completes, credit burns to 0, session terminates, and UI redirects to login.
gatekeeper.rateLimiter: IP-based lockout after 5 failed key attempts (15 minutes lockout)

adminPortal.keyGenerator: High-entropy military-grade generator with 18.4 Quintillion combinations (ABI-BW-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)
adminPortal.rateLimiter: IP-based lockout after 3 failed admin attempts (15 minutes lockout)
features: Live Key Generator (Stone Island g3, Blackwave g3, Stone Island f3, Under armour f3)

antiInspection.antiDebuggerTrap: High-frequency dynamic performance timing loop triggers breakpoint stall if DevTools open
antiInspection.consolePoisoning: console.log, warn, debug, info, trace, dir, table overridden with silent no-ops

chunkStreaming.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 signature per chunk verified on client
chunkStreaming.antiScraping: Out-of-order chunk retrieval triggers immediate session destruction
chunkStreaming.zeroPlaintext: Raw binary is never exposed over HTTP responses; only encrypted ciphertext bytes + MAC + CRC

drmAndAntiPiracy.hardwareLocking: Scraped STM32 Silicon 96-bit Unique ID (UID) permanently locks to key on flash initialization.

emulatorSpecification.title: StarCFW G3 Display Emulator
emulatorSpecification.sourceCore: StarCFW_G3_emulator.zip (Python Unicorn / LVGL cluster engine reference)

clusterRegisters.ctl_headlight: Toggle headlight on/off with high-beam icon
clusterRegisters.ctl_turn_light: 0: Off, 1: Left, 2: Right, 3: Hazard with synchronized ticker and sound
clusterRegisters.brake_on: Hold-to-brake triggers (!) BRAKE warning, cuts power, decelerates with regen sound
clusterRegisters.boost_mode: Overboost up to 55 km/h with neon shift flare
clusterRegisters.odo_or_trip: Toggle Trip distance vs Total Odometer distance

sounds: playBootChime: StarCFW 4-tone ascending startup arpeggio (G4, C5, E5, C6)
setThrottleSound: Dynamic brushless motor pitch-shift whine (160Hz -> 1060Hz)

phases: Phase 1: StarCFW / Blackwave G3 logo fade-in & boot chime
Phase 2: Instrument cluster sweep & self-test pass
Phase 3: Transition into live HUD dashboard
